  INSTRUCTIONS:
  1. Press Ctrl + F in Notepad to quickly search for any Title or Artist.
  2. Note the 5-digit or 6-digit Song Code.
  3. On the RT-Spark board, press BOTH UP + DOWN buttons to open NUMBER SELECT.
  4. Enter the digits using LEFT/RIGHT (move) and UP/DOWN (change).
  5. Hold UP/DOWN or click CENTER (PA0) to immediately play the song!
